raw_segments.text: He was going on with some wild reminiscences about his tomahawk pipe, which it seemed had
in its two uses both brained his foes and soothed his soul when we were directly attracted
The strong vapor now completely filling the contracted hole, it began to tell upon him.
He breathed with a sort of muffledness, then seemed troubled in the nose, then revolved
over once or twice, then sat up and rubbed his eyes.
